title: Vallée's 260,000-case Capela database

tellings.quote: 260,000 cases, like I said, the Capela database that he made.

plain: The UFO researcher Jacques Vallée is said to have built a collection of some 260,000 reported cases, called the Capela database. A researcher named Jason Simosa mentions it in passing, without saying more about where the figure comes from. It is raised to show how large a record of sightings one researcher has gathered.
